spec.body_markdown:
## Speed

Speed tells you how much distance is covered per unit of time: v = d / t.

It is a **scalar** quantity — it has a size (magnitude) but no direction. Saying a car travels at 60 km/h describes its speed; saying it travels at 60 km/h *north* describes its velocity.

**Average vs instantaneous speed:** average speed is total distance divided by total time for a trip, while instantaneous speed is what a speedometer shows at one exact moment — it can change even while average speed stays the same.

Speed is always zero or positive; it can never be negative.
